# Galaxy Estates Properties

> Independent property advisors for Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, GIFT City, Dubai and Thailand. Flats and offices in Ahmedabad and GIFT City, land and industrial plots across Gujarat, and selected overseas projects. Proprietor: Er. Samir Dabhi. Based in Kalol, Gandhinagar district, Gujarat, India. Phone: +91 84880 62309.

We help with buying and selling only. We do not handle rentals. We are real estate advisors, not a law firm, and nothing on the site is legal advice. Prices, sizes and availability come from developers and owners and can change, so confirm them with us before you decide.
